blue-fire.name: Blue Fire
blue-fire.text: Blue Fire The storyline explores the creation of TerraGroup's EMP weapon. You can start the storyline by picking up an evacuation flyer from the  EMERCOM camp about evacuating Tarkov after the EMP pulse. Find location of the note on the Woods map Woods Emergency Note starting the Blue Fire quest Blue Fire Find location of the note on the Interchange map Interchange Emergency Note starting the Blue Fire quest on Interchange Blue Fire The flyer can be found in the Woods, at the EMERCOM location. Talking to Mechanic sends you to Streets of Tarkov or Customs, where you need to visit the gathering spots of Scavs or Cultists. Mechanic believes they might have dragged parts of the bomb. To progress through the quest, you need to go to Streets of Tarkov and head to the marked room at 13 Checkered (requires a strange key). The debris is located in the corner of the room in a pot. You can also find it in a locked room on the second floor of LEXOS (requires a key that drops from Kaban or can be bought at the flea market). Streets of Tarkov Streets of Tarkov Mechanics device in the marked room Blue Fire Streets of Tarkov Mechanics device in LEXOS closed room  Blue Fire Location of the fragment on Streets of Tarkov Path to the room Fragment in a pot After handing over the fragment to Mechanic, the trader will ask you to install a hacking device in the server room on the Laboratory map. If you die, the item will be available for purchase from Mechanic. Find the planting spot in the server room on the Lab map The Lab Planting location of Mechanic device Blue Fire Location for installing the hacking device on the map Required Server Room Device Installation Location Device for Hacking After placing it, you need to talk to Mechanic. The trader will give a small amount of information about Item 1156. Mechanic will also ask about the fate of the EMP bomb fragment. If you decide to keep the fragment for yourself, you will receive the "I Need It More" achievement. If you sell it to Mechanic, he will reward you with 1,500,000 rubles. We head to the Laboratory again. In the office above the Streets passage, on one of the tables, there will be a note stating that the Item 1156 blueprint has been sent via a "Post of Rus" package. These are three cassette tapes. The first cassette tape spawns at the entrance of the Post Office on a table. The second one spawns inside, it is not locked. The third one spawns on the coffee machine in the Post Office. Streets of Tarkov Streets of Tarkov The first cassette on the table at the Post entrance. accidental-witness.name: Accidental Witness
accidental-witness.text: Accidental Witness The storyline revolves around Kozlov, a repair box worker on the Customs territory, who at first glance owes someone a significant debt. You can start the quest by approaching the white Logan in the dormitory parking lot. You may need to climb on it to activate the quest. Find Kozlov's car on Customs map Customs Kozlov's car at the dormitory Accidental Witness White Logan in the parking lot Next, head to the two-story dormitory, to room 110, which has a note hanging on the door that needs to be read. The key to room 110 can be found on the Customs map, in warehouse No. 17, in a locker located in the dressing room on the first floor near the stairs, behind the wall paintings. One key is guaranteed to spawn in each raid. Find room 110 on Customs map Customs Room 110 double-storey dormitory Accidental Witness Find spawn of the key for room 110 on Customs map Customs Spawn of key from room 110 two-storey dormitory Accidental Witness   Room 110: note beside the door Warehouse No. 17 marked on the map Changing room The locker to search Key in the locker Inside the room, on the bedside table, there will be a note, after which you will need to talk to traders about the journalist Anastasia Mikhailova, with whom Kozlov tried to get in touch. Note We need Prapor. He will send us to Streets, to the apartment of his accomplice, which is located at Zmeisky, 3. The apartment is on the first floor of the house on the left when entering. To enter the apartment, you will need a key. Inside the apartment, there are several documents, but they are not required to advance the quest. Find the accomplice's apartment on Streets of Tarkov map Streets of Tarkov The accomplice's apartment on Zmeyeskaya, 3 Accidental Witness Building location on Streets of Tarkov Building entrance The required apartment After entering the apartment and speaking with Skiier, he will send us to Prapor. Arshavir will provide us with the address where the journalist lived: Chekanskaya Street, house 13, apartment on the second floor. Find Anastasia's apartment on Streets of Tarkov map Streets of Tarkov Apartment of Anastasia, Chekannaya, 13, 2nd floor Accidental Witness Apartment location on Streets of Tarkov Building entrance Apartment The door is locked, and attempting to break it down will complete the task. Our character thinks about searching the entrance for information about Anastasia. Anastasia's mailbox In her mailbox, there is a letter and a newspaper sticking out. Picking them up and reading them will give us a new lead - we now need to find the courier Pasha, who, according to the letter, knows where to find Kozlov. Pasha, or rather his belongings, can be found at Customs, behind a two-story dormitory. Find the location of Pasha's body with envelope Customs The envelope of Pasha's body Accidental Witness Letter beside the body At the scene of the attack, we find an opened envelope. Our PMC thinks that it would be a good idea to find out who is covering the dormitory, to ask them what happened to Pasha. The next step will be a conversation with Skiier, who will tell us about Reshala, but he won't be able to arrange a meeting with him, so we'll have to look for information on our own. Reshala's stash is located in a temporary shelter near the car service center. The key to it has a 10% drop chance from Reshala. Find Reshala's temporary base on Customs map Customs Reshala's temporary base Accidental Witness Reshala's temporary shelter Reshala's note House address on Shoreline Warning on the wall Inside the stash, we find a letter from Kozlov to a journalist, in which he writes that he has been waiting at the agreed location for several days; a note from Reshala to his people, which mentions the address of Kozlov's hideout - 3, Tsvetochnaya Street; and a note from someone named Nagano'98, who informs Reshala that some PMC will be coming to him soon. Nagano'98 is likely Skiier, who decided to inform his friend about our visit. All that's left to do is head to the Shore, to the village by the tunnel, find house 3 on Tsvetochnaya Street, and retrieve the compromising evidence tape from the flowerbed by the entrance. Find the cassete with compromising material on Shoreline map Shoreline Compromising material on the cassette Accidental Witness Evidence location on Shoreline The required house The required house Evidence in the garden bed Retrieving the tape completes the story "Random Witness" and the player receives the achievement "Pay Your Debt". falling-skies.name: Falling Skies
falling-skies.text: Falling Skies The storyline explores the crash of a plane that fell on the Woods map and the fate of its passengers. The task begins after completing the Mechanic's quest "Tour" at the Factory. Find the crushed plane on the Woods map Woods The crashed plane Falling Skies After finding the plane in the Woods, Prapor sends us to search for the Gelendwagen that was used to transport a TerraGroup employee, who had a flash drive with data about the plane. Without information on the vehicle's location, Prapor sends us to Therapist, saying that she definitely has such information. Elvira is not willing to help us for free and demands $2000 for the information. To progress through the tasks, it is not necessary to give the dollars to Therapist; it is enough to find the flash drive in the SUV. Gelendwagen on the Shoreline Flash drive under the car wheel USB flash drive on the car suspension The SUV is located on Shoreline, by the collapsed tunnel. The flash drive is under its rear left wheel or on the threshold. Find Gelendwagen on the Shoreline map Shoreline Gelendvagen with flash drive Falling Skies After handing over the flash drive, Prapor asks you to wait. You need to wait for approximately 1 hour, after which Pavel Yegorovich will send you to retrieve a black box from a plane and lay it on Shoreline, in a collapsed house in the Fisherman's Village. Find plane's black box on the Woods map Woods Plane's Black Box Falling Skies Find black box planting spot on Shoreline map Shoreline Black box planting spot Falling Skies Woods, black box location The box up close The place where you need to plant the black box After laying the item and returning to Prapor, you will receive a task to transfer 3 battery packs, 5 circuit boards, and 2 toolkits to the trader, which will be needed to decrypt the black box. After handing Prapor the Electronics Kit, you will have to wait for approximately 4 hours. His assistant has left a flash drive and transcript at the chairman's house on Shoreline. Find house on Shoreline map Shoreline House with Prapor's Documents Falling Skies Shoreline, chairman's house location Chairman's house One of the flash drive spawn locations. On the plate or nearby. Transcript spawn under the mattress After handing over the flash drive and transcript to Prapor, the trader will begin reading the document, but he'll receive a phone call and chase us out of his office. We'll have to wait for another hour. This leads us to the final part of the story, where Prapor asks us to retrieve a secured case containing the "Ticket out of Tarkov." The search for the case takes us back to the airplane, with the object of our search located in the cockpit. Find crushed plane on Woods map Woods The crashed plane Falling Skies The case is shaped like a long item. We pick up the case and return to Prapor. As we enter, an important choice presents itself , completing the story "Falling Skies": give the case to Prapor or not. Important choice Choice: "Give the case to Prapor" The choice unlocks an achievement "Man's Word".  The choice also rewards 1 million roubles from Prapor. Choice: "The case stays with me" The choice unlocks an achievement "Just Business" You also receive a case in a message from SYSTEM. It is considered a special item. If you chose this option, Prapor will be very angry and your reputation with him will decrease significantly. You will be able to return it in the storyline "Ticket". Find the crashed plane. Woods The crashed plane Gather information about the crashed plane. Find a flash drive in one of the Gelandewagen off-road vehicles. Shoreline Gelendvagen with flash drive Transfer $2000 to the Therapist. Pass the flash drive to Prapor. tour.name: Tour
tour.text: Tour     The storyline is a series of small tasks from traders, completing which will unlock access to all traders and maps. It introduces the player to key characters in the game and the main types of tasks that need to be completed to progress through the game. At the beginning, contacts are only available with Therapist and Scav. After completing their small tasks, you will gradually gain access to Snowflake, Mechanic, Prapor, and Peacekeeper, in that order. Shoreline map with watch tower and Terminal Terminal Watch tower Intercom The task "Find the entrance to the Port Terminal" is considered complete when approaching the Customs - 11 checkpoint on the Shoreline location. Approach with caution, as the machine gunners on the towers around the Terminal are hostile towards players and will open fire if you enter their line of sight. To find the radio for communication with the military, go from the "Road to Customs" exit towards the Terminal. The radio will be under the tower. Find Watchtower on the map Shoreline The Watchtower near the checkpoint Tour After speaking with the military at the Terminal, to progress through the quest, you will need to unlock access to Lighthouse and Reserve. To access Lighthouse, give Mechanic 20,000 dollars. To access Reserve, give Prapor 5 PMC tokens. To unlock access to Streets, give Therapist 250,000 rubles. To complete the "Tour" storyline, you will also need to find a lab key card.  Once you have obtained it, enter the Laboratory through one of the exits: either at Factory or Streets. Transit to Labs from Factory Transit to Labs from Streets Upon entering the Lab, the task will update. Now you need to visit several locations on the map. The Lab The Lab Exit through the drainage Tour The Lab Server room Tour The Lab Top managers office Tour Find exit through the drainage on the map The Lab Exit through the drainage Tour Find Server room on the map The Lab Server room Tour Find Top managers office on the map The Lab Top managers office Tour Labs P After visiting all the locations and exiting the map, you will gain access to the Laboratory. Completing access to all locations concludes the "Tour" storyline and the player receives the "Walkabout" achievement. Talk to the Skiier. Give the Skiier items from the "Building Materials" category (5 pcs.). Talk to the Mechanic. Survive and extract from the Factory map. they-are-already-here.name: They Are Already Here
they-are-already-here.text: They Are Already Here This quest will tell you about a mysterious cult that has settled in the territory of Tarkov. You can start the quest by picking up and reading a note about the "Eye of the World", or by killing a Cultist. Notes appear in marked circles scattered throughout Tarkov. A note in a marked circle on the Woods map A note in a marked circle on the Woods map A note in a marked circle on the Shoreline map in the house on fisherman island To progress through the quest, you need to go to the Lighthouse map, to the area of the flooded village. The required house is located in the center of the eastern part of the village. Find the required house on the Lighthouse map Lighthouse House of cultists in a flooded village They Are Already Here Inside the premises, there is a torture room where you can find an audio cassette on a chair and the victim's apartment key on the table. The key has few spawns in the house: wooden table, metal workbench, on the fallen over shelf, on the chair. The house in the village on the Lighthouse map The house A circle of cultists inside the house An audio cassette The key The key The key on the workbench The key indicates an apartment located in the central part of the city. It is located on the Streets of Tarkov map, in the courtyard behind the shopping center on Klimov Street. You need to go up to the second floor of the building. The apartment will be located on the right side of the staircase. Inside the apartment, you will notice a white door that needs to be kicked in. You need to search the room and find the first audio cassette of the cult victim, the book and the note. Find appartment on Streets of Tarkov map Streets of Tarkov Appartment of cultists victim They Are Already Here  The apartment location on Streets of Tarkov The door of the appartment Inside the apartment Door to the room Victim's audio cassette The book on the shelf in bookcase The note to the right of the audio cassette At this stage, the investigation reaches a dead end, and you can't do without the help of traders. You need to go to Mechanic, but he doesn't provide specific information - you need to look for information among the cultists. Next, to progress through the quest, you need to kill 2 cultist priests. After killing them, nothing of interest is found, and the character decides that the next step in the investigation should be to study the cultists' gathering places. These are marked rooms. Upon entering, read the priest's note lying on the shelf in the closet. A note in the stash A note in the stash Now we need to find 3 locations marked with the "Eye of the World", we need to search in Customs, Lighthouse and Woods. Heading to Customs, take a toolkit with you. The location we need for the storyline, called the "Sordi" watchtower, is located at the communication tower near the "Road to Customs" exit, in an orange temporary building. First, just enter inside and the storyline will update. Find the tower on Shoreline map Shoreline House at the tower They Are Already Here Location of the garage on the Customs map The Garage Now we need to inspect the surroundings - next to the tower lies the corpse of a man named Igor - apparently a former TerraGroup programmer who became a sectarian towards the end of his life. We will have to take a note from his hands, which will tell us that the "Sordi" tower needs to be repaired. Location of Igor's body The body near the tower The note Head back to the weather station, repair the "Sordi," and exit the location. Repair location The next stop is Woods. There are two houses in the old village that need to be visited as part of the story. First, enter the house between the village and the church, and then the house in the center of the village. Notably, this house has a board with photographs of objects important to the Cult. A piece of the Tarkov Lights newspaper is hanging on it, which can be read. Find the required house on Woods map Woods Note in a cultists house in a flooded village They Are Already Here Location of houses in the Woods village on the map Inside the house Inside the house A board with a newspaper clipping The last map will be Lighthouse, it's all quite simple. We come to the lower shack, find the room ransacked by the cultists and a note on its balcony. Find the required balcony on Lighthouse map Lighthouse Note on the balcony of the lower cottage, 2nd floor They Are Already Here Lower shack on Lighthouse Cultist room Note on the balcony Next, exit the chalet and head towards the two-story house nearby. In front of it, there is a quad bike with the key to 14-4 KORD station, a semi-mythical station of the ARRS observation system, a stream from which was used to announce and show the first episode of the Raid series. Exit Customs. Find the quad bike on the Lighthouse map Lighthouse KORD key on a ATV They Are Already Here Quad bike with the key Talk to Mechanic. The conversation unlocks level 1 workbench crafting. Use the crafted key to restart the station. Crafting the key at the workbench After completing the crafting process, take a regular flash drive and an access card with you and head to the Interchange. You need to reach the Power Plant, turn on the power at the station, and descend to the basement. Open the door with the access card, use the pass inside, and install the flash drive to download the data. Find the power station lever on Interchange map Interchange Power podstation lewer They Are Already Here Morituri te salutant After turning on the circuit breaker in the server room and installing the flash drive, a safe opens at the entrance where you can retrieve the mysterious cultist tape. The quest requires you to survive and exit the Interchange. Location of the Power Plant on Customs Circuit breaker Card reader Keycard Panel Insert the flash drive Safe with audio cassette After returning to the Hideout, we need to return to the Interchange and retrieve the flash drive with the downloaded data from the server. We go down to the station, where the player has the opportunity to immediately take the quest flash drive or get a hidden achievement. Note The required table with a button underneath it. Button. Flash drive To obtain the achievement, you need to disconnect the station from external agents. This can be done using the button under the table in the server room. Now you can safely retrieve the previously installed flash drive and return to Mechanic. batya.name: Batya
batya.text: Batya The story revolves around the fate of a BEAR PMC veteran squad. You can start the quest by: approaching some of the BEAR corpses scattered across the maps; arriving at one of the BEAR PMC checkpoints; picking up and inspecting (using the book button) the patch of the Bogatyrs group in the temporary shelter under the power line near the new gas station. The patch can also be found under the corpse of a BEAR fighter near the wrecked BTRD in the Woods convoy. Find place of start of Batya quest on Customs map Customs Place of start of the Batya Quest Batya Find shack with patch on Customs map Customs BEAR clothing patch in the shack Batya    Find wrecked convoy with patch on Woodsmap Woods BEAR patch for clothes at the wrecked BRDM Batya Radio tower on customs Patch location Patch location, Prapors lost convoy on Woods Eger is the only trader who will tell us about the group. He sends us to search for positions in the Interchange and Woods, where the required items for the quest will be located. In the Woods, at the "Ryabina" position, you can find Voevoda's report and Strelok's amulet. Woods Woods The Amulet of the Strelok' on the Box at "Ryabina" Camp Batya Woods Voevoda's report in the camp "Ryabina" Batya Ryabina outpost Ryabina outpost, location of hostage report Raport The Path to the Sagittarius Amulet Amulet At Interchange, at the "Nest" outpost, you will find: the group's operation report, another piece of the note with a code, and a map with signal triangulation. Find “Nest” outpost on Interchange map Interchange “Nest” outpost Batya "Nest" outpost, Interchange Checkpoint "Nest" Personal information inside the tent on the bed Note with the code on the crate  Report near the guitar Map in the sleeping bag Cassete on the table Note on the blue chair After finding all the documents, you will need to head back to the Woods, where, not far from the old depot, is Moreman's grave, on which lies his token, phone, and a piece of the note with code. This unlocks the crafting of two Moreman audio cassette tapes at the workbench. Workbench crafting While the cassettes are being crafted, head to the Interchange map and go to the IDEA store. There is a food court at the entrance, which the Bogatyrs have converted into a "Carousel" outpost. Interchange Interchange The Forpost “Carousel” Batya Interchange Taran's Postcard Batya   By searching the first and second floors, you can find Voevoda's dictaphone, an audio cassette with his musings, Taranal's postcard, Tarana's, Voevoda's, and Strelka's personal files, as well as Strelka's note. "Carousel" outpost "Carousel" outpost Voivode's voice recorder on the bistro table Taran's personal file The Voivode's personal file is on the table by the stairs. Sagittarius's personal file on the chair A note from a Sagittarius under a bottle on a box To proceed further, you need to build a level 3 scouting center. After building it, it turns out that the trail of the missing BEAR squad should be looked for with the Keeper. At the same time, the "Network Provider" quest chain will become available. Make sure to complete the "New Acquaintance" quest before continuing with the storyline. The Keeper will require you to bring all of the Bogatyrs' personal belongings: Voevoda's dictaphone, Tarana's postcard, Strelka's amulet, M Having made contact with the commander of the Bogatyrs, he will ask us to prove our "professional suitability". To do this, you will need to: ● Raise the "Strength" skill to level 15; ● Raise the "Stress Resistance" skill to level 10; ● Raise the "Light Machineguns" skill to level 5; ● Raise the "Assault Rifles" skill to level 10; ● Kill 15 any targets without dying; ● Kill 4 PMC scavs without dying. After successfully passing the "interview", we make contact with Voevoda. Instead of him, Taran will answer, a machine gunner of the group. He will give us the first combat task: to find the trail of traitors who set up an ambush on the squad. The search will lead us to the BEAR checkpoint on Lighthouse. On the boat, in the fire in the middle of the checkpoint, there will be a note that says that Prapor leaked information about the squad to the traitors. Find BEAR checkpoint on Lighthouse map Lighthouse BEAR Camp with a Note Batya The BEAR camp, Lighthouse Note in a BEAR camp Note in a BEAR camp Having found evidence playing against Prapor, we exit the location and contact the officer to ask him a couple of questions. During the interrogation, it will become clear that Prapor only provided courier services to deliver orders from a certain "General". Prapor's people left notes in the circles of the cultists, one of which we will have to inspect. We exit to Woods and head to the cultist circle between Sawmill and the temporary checkpoint. That's where we will find the note we need. Find the cultist circle on the Woods map Woods A marked circle with a note Batya Note in a marked circle on Woods Marked circle with a note in a fisherman's house After reading the note, we learn that the Keeper has "blessed" General and is also involved in this story. From the conversation with him, we come to a compromise - the Keeper will deal with General in exchange for safety guarantees from Voevoda. The commander agrees, but adds that the Keeper will also have to provide documents confirming the presence of "Unknowns" in the Russian Armed Forces. The Keeper will need some time to prepare the documents. After 18-24 hours, we return to Lighthouse and pick up the documents lying by the Keeper's door on a sandbox box. Find the report on the box on Lighthouse map Lighthouse The report on a red wooden box Batya Picking up the documents completes the "Dad" storyline and the player receives the "It's all (not) a coincidence" achievement. the-labyrinth.name: The Labyrinth
the-labyrinth.text: The Labyrinth The storyline will tell you about "Labyrinth," an underground TerraGroup laboratory located beneath the "Lazurny Bereg" sanatorium. To begin the storyline, you need to approach the entrance to Labyrinth (behind a door that can be unlocked with the key to the "OOO KNOSSOS" premises). Find entrance to Labyrinth on Shoreline map Shoreline Entrance to the Labyrinth The Labyrinth After waiting for approximately 36 hours, Jaeger will open a barter for the Labyrinth key card in exchange for 1 moonshine, 2 vodka, and 2 sausages. The barter is available 2 times per shipment. In return, he asks you to find out about a group of PMC BEAR fighters who stormed Labyrinth during evacuation. After successfully completing the operation, the group lost contact with command, and Labyrinth was closed. Bartering the Labyrinth key card from Jaeger At Labyrinth, you'll need to visit several points, picking up notes and finding the bodies of the group fighters. Additionally, to unlock room number 6 on the map, you'll need to retrieve a key from one of the lab assistants, marked on the map as number 2. the-unheard.name: The Unheard
the-unheard.text: The Unheard The story will tell about the mysterious group of Unknowns, which caused the events in Tarkov to begin. You can start the quest by picking up and reading a note on the TerraGroup guard post. Find note at the security post on Streets of Tarkov map Streets of Tarkov Note at the security post, starting quest The Unheard The Unheard Find note at the office on Ground Zero map Ground Zero Note at the security post, starting quest The Unheard on Ground Zero The Unheard The note is located on the Streets of Tarkov map. Guard Post Target door Note Next, we head to the Laboratory. Here, you will need to collect several documents about TerraGroup's activities. In the office above the elevator with access to the Streets, there will be a fax about cargo transportation, and below, in the main testing area, in a small block, there will be a document about changes in inter-enterprise interaction. The Lab The Lab Fax for transportation of goods The Unheard The Lab Documents to the Interaction of Enterprises The Unheard Target locations on the Laboratory map Required office Fax on the office table Test Site Document After gathering all necessary documents in the Laboratory, you need to head to the "Factory" location. In the workshop with the crashed helicopter, near the barrels with "Blue Ice" written on the yellow barrels, lies another document. Find documents on yellow barrels on Factory map Factory Documents on yellow barrels The Unheard Location of barrels at Factory Document on yellow barrels Next, you need to head to the Streets of Tarkov. We're interested in Rzhevsky's service vehicle (a gray Gelandewagen), which is located near the LexOs car dealership. The required item is located between the two front seats. Find the car on the Streets of Tarkov map Streets of Tarkov Hard disk in the car The Unheard Location of the gray Gelandewagen on the Streets of Tarkov Gray Gelandewagen The required hard drive To progress through the quest, you need to extract the data from Rzhevsky's hard drive using a level 2 Intelligence Center. The crafting process takes approximately 12 hours. Crafting at the Level 2 Intelligence Center After decoding, it becomes known that the data with the catalyst test reports is located in a locked room at the Factory (requires the "Polychem" keycard). The necessary documents are inside the room - on a shelf and in a safe. Find the TerraGroup warehouse on Factory map Factory Blue Ice documents at the TerraGroup warehouse The Unheard The required room at the Factory Entrance to the room Report Documents Documents lead back to the Laboratory, specifically to the lecture room. In the auditorium, you can find two audio cassettes: the first one is lying on the floor next to the first desk, and the second one is next to the laptop on the next desk. There are currently known cases of softlock when picking up the first cassette first and then the second. First, pick up and listen to the cassette on the table, and then the one on the floor. The Lab The Lab Audio cassette on the floor in the lecture room The Unheard The Lab Audio cassette near the laptop in the lecture room The Unheard Lecture room on the Laboratory Cassette 1 Cassette 2 Information from the audio cassettes leads to the "Lazurny Bereg" sanatorium on the Shoreline map. On the first floor, in the western wing, we find a note that can be used to learn that the scientist was settled in room 305 (of the eastern wing). Find the 305 room on the Shoreline map Shoreline 305 room of East Wing of Sanatorium The Unheard Location of the table with the note in the Sanatorium on Shoreline The right table Note In the room you can find a service apartment key, a note under the phone wire, and a flash drive in the laptop on the table. Room 305 in the Sanatorium on the Shoreline Room 305 Key Note The flash drive in the laptop Next, you need to decrypt the flash drive at a level 2 Intel Center. Crafting takes approximately 12 hours. Crafting at the level 2 Intel Center After decryption is complete, you need to seek help from Mechanic. The trader offers to help from the Electronics expert for a substantial sum - 5,000,000 rubles. Hand over the flash drive and wait. Conversation with Mechanic While waiting, Kerman contacts you. He says that we won't get anything useful from Mechanic and Electronik. He also informs you that the files on the flash drive might be part of some key. After the conversation, three new crafts appear in the Intelligence Center, involving green, red, and blue key cards. Talking to Kerman Craft a rewritten green key card (others won't work), take the key to the TerraGroup corporate apartment, and head to Streets, specifically to the Cardinal residential complex. Enter the building closest to the exhibition center and go up to the second floor. Open the first apartment. Find the corporate apartment on Streets of Tarkov map Streets of Tarkov Corporate Apartment of TerraGroup The Unheard The desired house on Streets of Tarkov, Cardinal residential complex TerraGroup corporate apartment There will be a door with a card reader inside. Among all this debris, you will need to find 4 important documents: about the Keeper, about protocol "O", a report for TG Worldwide, and an order from the TG Worldwide headquarters. Inside the room The order Report Protocol Keeper Document Read them all, after which the quest will be completed. the-ticket.name: The Ticket
the-ticket.text: The Ticket To activate this quest, you need to complete the quests from the "Heavens in Flames" series, as well as build a level 1 Scav base in your Hideout. Once this is done, Mr. Keriman will contact you. After setting up the Scav base, there will be a short conversation, which may differ depending on the choice made at the end of the "Heavens in Flames" quest. The quests have different consequences, so choose wisely. Some time later, Keriman will contact you again and tell you that you need to unlock the case. To get help with opening the case, you need to contact Mechanic. The trader says that opening the case won't be quick and you'll need to find the "Experimental Signal Suppressor", which can be found in the Laboratory. The required item is located in the lecture hall on the first bench. It can also spawn on the round table in the "cats" area and on the table in the research room in the residential module. The lecture hall is located on the Laboratory map. Signal Suppressor Signal Suppressor from Kotov Signal Suppressor in the research room in the residential module After finding the signal suppressor and talking to Mechanic, a new craft will become available at the workbench, allowing you to open a secured case. The craft takes 56 hours and requires Workbench level 1. After finding the signal suppressor and talking to Mechanic, a new craft will become available at the workbench, allowing you to open a secured case. The craft takes 56 hours and requires Workbench level 1. Crafting on a level 1 workbench, which unlocks a case. The crafting process shown in the screenshot takes 55 hours and 34 minutes due to the "Hand Tool" skill. After completing the crafting and opening the case in the stash, you receive an RFID card in the name of Kruglov, a random colored key card, a laboratory access key card, and Euros. Case contents. The task requires reading the instructions for the RFID card, which we pick up from the mail and read in the reference book. We go to Kerman for a conversation in the intel center. Instruction for the RFID card Kerman offers the player cooperation. The player has a choice: accept his proposal or refuse and try to escape Tarkov with the data from the case. Choice: "Cooperate with Mr. Kerman - YES" Kerman's choice Kerman will give the player a new task to find the following items: Let's head to the lab and find the master pass in the safe in the new molecular room, which can be accessed with a black key card. Here, you can also randomly find an RFID card, which can also spawn in marked rooms on other locations. The master pass is in the safe. The condition "Find an RFID card encryption device" cannot be fulfilled. To progress the storyline, survive 3 times on the Laboratory. Return to Kerman and report that you were unable to find the device. He suggests that raiders may have taken the encryptors. As a solution, Kerman proposes to negotiate with Mechanic: his friend, Electronik, may have such a device available. Here, the player is faced with another timegate - Mechanic needs 24 hours to contact and clarify all the details. Dialogue with Mechanic After the time gate, Mechanic asks you to transfer 40 bitcoin to him as payment for helping Electron. Once you give him the required amount, you receive a key to the apartment at 14A, Klimova Street, where the RFID card encryption device is hidden. The device is located under a small table with a pig. Mechanic also unlocks a key exchange for this key for 1 bitcoin. Bartering the key with Mechanic Head to Streets of Tarkov and find the required building. You need the second apartment. The device will be located under a small table with a pig. Location of the apartment on Streets of Tarkov The required building Entering the entrance Required apartment Device under the table with the pig Device Having retrieved the device and escaped the location, we can start crafting, which will take ~51 hours. Crafting the RFID Card After completing the RFID card crafting task for the quest, head to the Beach location and approach the entrance to the Port Terminal. The attempt fails, and you need to speak with Prapor. He reveals that he decided not to reveal all the cards at once and was aware that the card wouldn't work. At this point, you're presented with another crucial decision: continue cooperating with Prapor or decline his proposal and search for another way to escape Tarkov. If during the dialogue you respond with: "Seriously? You decided to play with me? Screw off with your games!", it won't trigger a storyline choice and will be considered an automatic refusal of further cooperation, earning you the achievement "Enough of your games!". This achievement will also be obtained if you refuse during the storyline choice "Help Prapor find compromising information on TerraGroup?" Choice: "Help Prapor find compromising information on TerraGroup? — YES" Plot Choice #3 A dialogue with Prapor will take place here, in which he will suggest taking down the TerraGroup company, but for this, you need to find a lot of incriminating evidence, in the search for which he is ready to help. To do this, you need to complete all storyline quests, the result of each quest is one of the necessary pieces of evidence. The full list of major incriminating evidence will be presented below. After several documents have been handed over, a conversation with Prapor will take place, which will lead to the final plot choice. The choice: "Continue searching for incriminating evidence on TerraGroup for Mr. Prapor? - YES" | Ending "The Savior" Story Choice #4 This story choice leads to the better ending in the game - "Savior". As part of this ending, it is necessary to hand over to Prapor all the compromising evidence that is obtained in different storylines. The fuel catalyst test report  (“I’ve found information about Blue Ice. And it’s not a fuel catalyst, as claimed to the whole world.”) - “Unknowns” storyline, TerraGroup locker room in the Factory basement (Polychem keycard). The fuel catalyst test report on the safe The fuel catalyst test report on the safe Report on the Deployment of an Agent Network  (“Here is the evidence that the Unheard  agents are embedded within government institutions of multiple countries.”) — part of the  “Batya”  storyline, located opposite the entrance to the Lightkeepers room, on a red sand-filled box. Report Report opposite the Lightkeepers room entrance Document mentioning The Guardian  (“TerraGroup is full of Unheard agents.”) - storyline “The Unheard”, located on Streets of Tarkov, A.P. residence, in a room locked with an electronic lock. Document mentioning The Guardian Document mentioning The Guardian Item specification No. 1156  ("An experimental EMP weapon developed by TerraGroup was used over the city.") is a Blue Fire storyline document, located in a blue van next to the "Post of Rus" department on the Streets of Tarkov map. Item Specification No. 1156 Item Specification No. 1156 ARRS System Specification  ("TerraGroup had a large-scale surveillance system.") is an They Are Here storyline document, given by Mechanic after handing over the data flash drive from the ARRS station. The ARRS system specification The ARRS system specification A compromising audiocassette  (“Deputy Minister Shkurenko tried to make a deal with a criminal group.”) - the storyline “Accidental Witness”, is located on the Shoreline map, in the flowerbed at st. Tsvetochnaya, 3. An audiocassette An audiocassette Research Report on the “Labyrinth” Facility  (“I have data on the illegal and brutal experiments conducted at the TerraGroup site.”) — part of the  “The Labyrinth”  storyline, located on the Shoreline map near the drainage outlet next to the “Norvinsky” port terminal. Research Report on the “Labyrinth” Facility Research Report on the “Labyrinth” Facility Transcript of the Conversation with Miss A.  (“I have a recording of a conversation between high-ranking TerraGroup executives. They’re talking about controlling the Big Seven and some kind of global changes in the world.”) — part of the  “The Ticket”  storyline, located on the Streets of Tarkov map inside a safe in the apartments of the  Cardinal  residential complex. Transcript of a conversation with Miss A. This document appears after receiving the storyline "Ticket," an optional task to "visit Kruglov's apartment on the Streets of Tarkov." Head to the Streets of Tarkov, to the "Cardinal" residential complex, and go up to the second floor. You can enter the right apartment by moving along the right wall. To enter, you need the "apartment key in Cardinal residential complex." Inside, you need to find the room with a painting and a broken flower. The safe is located to the left of the bed, but it will be locked. Inside, you need to find the room with a painting and a broken flower. The safe is located to the left of the bed, but it will be locked. The right room To open it, you need to approach the painting, which will bring up a context menu for interaction. The painting After that, you need to use the electronic panel, which will open the safe. To do this, you must have the TerraGroup Labs key card (black). The panel is behind the painting As a result of all actions, the safe will be opened, and the required transcript will be inside. Transcript Additionally, you can hand over small compromising materials on TerraGroup (audiocassettes, notes, etc.). There are 32 of them in total. Dialogue with Prapor about handing over the compromising materials For this, you will receive the hidden achievement "A little something". After handing over 8 documents, the player will receive a secure "Alpha-1" container with TerraGroup compromising materials in their in-game mail. Alpha-1 container with TerraGroup compromising information After receiving the container, speak with Prapor again. He will provide us with hash codes for reprogramming the keycard through his trusted associate, who turns out to be Fence. If the relationship with Fence is below 4.0, he will refuse to do business with us, so we need to go farm. Fence After gaining the trader's trust, he will give us a task: ● IN PVP ZONE - Meet Scav at the joint extraction point in Reserve and Woods; ● In the PVE ZONE - Kill 5 PMC's in one raid on Customs and 5 PMC's in one raid on Interchange. You cannot kill Scavs until you complete these tasks. After completing the tasks, you will need to grind further - to advance the storyline, you need to raise your reputation with the BTR driver to 0.4. To achieve this goal, you need to complete his quest chain. You must not go through the Skier branch in it. After completing the entire chain, go to the Scav and take the flash drive with hash codes from him. Fence gives you the flash drive. Flash Drive After talking to Prapor and receiving the flash drive, you will need to construct the "Solar Power" module in your Hideout (continuing the grind), as without it, the recipe for crafting a reprogrammed map to access the Terminal will not become available. Once the battery is installed, the crafting recipe will appear. Crafting a Reprogrammed Map After crafting the map, take it, and the container with compromising evidence, and under the cover of night, between 22:00 and 04:00, head to the Terminal. To do this, go to the intercom on the Customs map (recalling the Tour quest), use the key card, and proceed to the Terminal map by continuing down the road to the gates of Checkpoint 11. If you die on the Terminal map, you will need to craft the card again (~11 hours).  Choice: "Continue searching for compromising evidence on TerraGroup for Mr. Kerman - NO" | Ending "Debtor" Having told Kerman that we're not his errand boys and that there are other people in Tarkov who can help us escape, we sever contact with him. If we ask other traders about the way out of Tarkov again, we'll be met with refusal. Next, depending on whether the Lightkeeper has been unlocked, two possible paths open up - if the Lightkeeper is unlocked, we go to him, otherwise we go to Prapor. The Lightkeeper route. The trader knows why we've come and offers us a deal - we'll work for him, and he'll provide us with a key that will grant us access to the Terminal. We accept the job. Our first task will be to collect topographic survey materials on Lighthouse, Woods, Customs, Ground Zero, and Factory. Some material spawn points are listed below. Materials at Facto On the Ground Zero, the materials are located in Office No. 4, behind the TerraGroup Scientists’ Office Key. This is the same office where the HDD for the “Saving the Mole” quest is found. Materials at Ground Zero On Woods, the materials are stuck in the car door at the entrance to the hangar at the Lumber Mill. Materials at Woo Materials at Customs are located in a room behind the office of the head of the enterprise, accessible with the Customs Office Key. Materials at Customs On Lighthouse, the materials are located in the upper chalet, on the second floor, on the armchair by the fireplace. Materials on Lighthouse After collecting all the materials, begin crafting them in the Intelligence Center. You will also need a regular Military Flash Drive for the craft. Intelligence Center crafting After receiving the flash drive with the materials, head to the Lightkeeper. He will give you the next task — eliminate 30 PMCs on Woods and bring him 100 dogtags. After doing some work as the local John Wick, the Lightkeeper will ask the player to find the Cultist Charms in all marked rooms in the game, except for the marked room on Lighthouse. The charms can be collected and turned in one by one. Sectant's amulet Sectant's amulet Sectant's amulet Sectant Amulet Sectant Amulet Sectant Amulet After collecting the amulets, head to the Lighthouse peninsula, where in the general dormitory (Marked key), you will need to place the amulets. The Amulet Drop Location After dropping off all the amulets, report the completed task to the Lightkeeper. He will give you a key card that will allow you to access evacuation. Place the card in the special slot, and under the cover of night, from 22 to 4, head to the Terminal (see the end of the article for passage). Choice: "Cooperate with Mr. Keriman - NO" | Ending "Survivor" Cooperation Choice Keriman refuses to help us further in the storyline and cuts off communication. The player has a new task: "Use the Kruglov key card at Shoreline", however, after using it, the intercom at the entrance to the Terminal (from the Tour quest) refuses to recognize the pass. Intercom at Shoreline near the Terminal Prapor (quick final) We return to Prapor and ask for his help: he is willing to cooperate with us, but in exchange for an escape ticket from Tarkov, he will require 500,000,000 roubles from the player. Part of this amount is a moral compensation for the player not handing over the case to Prapor at the end of the "Falling skies" storyline. If the case was handed over to the trader, he will ask for 300,000,000 roubles. The task is to transfer the money to Prapor The Prapor asks us to complete a couple more tasks within 72 hours, or the quest will be failed. The tasks are as follows: - Craft an item in the Hideout and record incriminating evidence onto a flash drive - Kill 50 any targets on the Streets of Tarkov map - Kill 4 PMC scavs in a single raid (and survive) IMPORTANT: The crafting process takes 5 hours, and it is unlocked at the Intelligence Center. It will require you to find 4 report folders from TerraGroup: Finance, Personnel, Developments, and Reports. Location of all report folders in the Laboratory After that, report back to Prapor and proceed to the next stage. If the player manages to complete these tasks before the 72-hour timer expires, the achievement "I Am Speed" will be awarded. Prapor doesn't give us a keycard; instead, he gives a "note" that we need to take to the Terminal, approach the entrance of Checkpoint 11, and activate the transition. Make sure to holster your weapon, including melee, or the terminal's security will attack you. A note and a cutscene at the Terminal will trigger afterwards (see Terminal section at the end of this article). IMPORTANT : If you die in the Terminal, you can buy a new note with money from Prapor for 5,000,000 roubles. Choose: "Help Mr. Kerman in searching for compromising information on TerraGroup - NO" | Ending "Fallen"  Having refused to cooperate with Kerman, you'll have to find a new patron, which will be Prapor (Lightkeeper must be locked!). Dialogue with Prapor Prapor's Path. If in the first storyline choice the case was handed over to Prapor, he won't burden you with extra work, otherwise the trader will stage a show of punishment. Prapor's Quests You need to hand over: - 50 units of Military or Advanced Electronics. Can be purchased at the flea market and handed over. All at once! - One of the following containers: Teta/ Epsilon/ Kappa Secure Container - 40 Armor Repair Kits or Weapon Repair Kits. Can be purchased at the flea market and handed over. All at once! After completing all tasks, Prapor will report that a scientist from TerraGroup left a briefcase with some BO in the Reserve bunker, and it needs to be returned in order to gain access to the port. However, this information did not come to the trader for free, so it is necessary to compensate for the costs by paying a total of $1,000,000.  To retrieve the "Case with Hazardous Contents," you need to head to the technical storage room in the command section of the underground bunker system on the Reserve map. This room is located to the left of the airlock that leads to the flooded room. The room will be locked and requires a "RB-PCPTS Key" (buy on the flea market if you don't have one, it has a very low chance to drop). The required room in the Reserve bunker The case itself is located on one of the shelves. Shelves with the case Case with Hazardous Contents Next, we hand over the case and the money to Prapor, who will highly appreciate it and send you on a couple of days' leave. We give the case to Prapor We wait for information from Prapor For transferring the money and the case, you will receive the "Was That Worth It?" achievement Next, Prapor calls you to him and gives you a "flash drive with Prapor's hash codes," and a new crafting project appears in your Intelligence center. The crafting project requires: an RFID encryption device, a blank RFID card, a Khruglov Map, and the flash drive with Prapor's hash codes (see screenshot below). The crafting process takes 11 hours, and if you die in Terminal, you will have to re-do the craft in order to re-enter Terminal. Terminal Extraction. Escape from Tarkov. After completing all tasks and before heading to Customs, be sure to prepare: wear your best bulletproof vest and helmet. It will be very dark inside, so take a night vision device or rely on a flashlight. It's recommended to bring a backpack with necessary resources - a large amount of ammunition, medical supplies (including the Surv12 Field Surgical Kit) and be sure to bring a Tool Kit. Additionally, we recommend using the SJ6 TGLabs Combat Stimulator and the Meldonium drug. You can only enter Customs between 22:00 and 4:00. To open the path to Customs, approach the Intercom on the Shoreline map. Activate the working login panel and head to the transition to Customs. The transition is only available for 5 random PMC scavs in one raid, or for a group of up to three PMC scavs. A group of four or more PMC scavs will not be allowed to transition. The path to the boat and task completion (possibly not suitable for all endings, definitely suitable for the Prapor ending for 500 million rubles) At the beginning, you will see a cutscene: you are greeted by friendly NPCs and led to the first room, where you will find yourself without equipment. A map of the location is hanging on the wall, and nearby you can collect food, water, medicine, and other small consumables. You have about 15-20 seconds to pick up everything you need. After that, the next cutscene will start - the Terminal is under attack. After the video, you will again find yourself in the same room, with only armor, a helmet, and a rig.  Find this building on the map. Terminal The southern port Terminal has been under Russian Armed Forces control since the beginning of the Tarkov conflict. After the city was sealed off, the terminal was fortified and became the primary evacuation point, sought by both civilian refugees and PMC units. According to unconfirmed reports, TerraGroup personnel were also evacuated through this port. Spawn Location, Start of the Raid The Terminal walkthrough begins in this building The Ticket Next, you need to get to the Armory building, where your equipment is located. The door of the house will open, and outside, friendly fighters (do not shoot at them) are fighting with Scavs. Go outside and pick up the weapon and magazines from the corpse to the left of the entrance. Near the explosion site—where the pipes are—carefully inspect the blue electrical panel. Similar panels are scattered throughout the location. You need the one that is open, blinking with a red light, and slightly sparking. It must be repaired using a Toolset. boreas.text: Boreas There are several different ways to start the quest chain: Buying the poster on the Flea Market One of the easiest options is to purchase the required poster from the Flea Market, which immediately activates the start of the chain. Finding the poster in raids The poster can also be found manually during raids. The currently known spawn locations are: Customs  — the three-story dormitory; Ground Zero  — the starter tutorial corridor or a wall outside; Lighthouse  — the depot at the Rogue base, as well as the upper chalet: the poster is located on the cab of the Gazelle van opposite the entrance. Message from “The Station” After logging into the game, you may receive a message from “The Station.” Simply reading it will automatically begin the quest chain. This becomes available after unlocking Intelligence Center Level 3. Dialogue with Mr. Kerman If you complete the “Savior” ending and choose to cooperate with Kerman, during the quest involving the transfer of compromising TerraGroup documents you can ask him about possible leads. In response, Kerman will mention the acquisition of a marine contractor and direct you to Mechanic. This starts the “Borey” storyline. Quest start from Intelligence Center Level 3 Quest start from the poster on Streets of Tarkov Quest start from dialogue with Mr. Kerman After that, you need to speak with Mechanic. Once you talk to him, he sends you to repair a communications tower. Take a  Toolset  and head to the Woods location, to the tower near the Scav Bunker.  Find the tower on the Woods map Woods Place of repair communication tower at the Scav Bunker Boreas . Repair it (10 seconds), then return to Mechanic. Place of repair communication tower at the Scav Bunker Afterwards, Mechanic sends you to Lighthouse. At the Rogue base railway depot, you need to retrieve a folder with documents from the desk.  Find the folder on the Lighthouse map. Lighthouse Documents on the table in the depot on the Rogue base Boreas  Read the contents of the folder in the Tasks tab under quest items. Documents on the table in the depot on the Rogue base Next, you need to find transportation to the Icebreaker. To do this, you must arrange passage with the BTR Driver and extraction from the Icebreaker with Prapor. Depending on your choices in the  Falling Skies Falling Skies  storyline, Prapor may offer three different options: Quest case: “Ticket Not Found”  — he will send you to kill 30 Scavs on Reserve and launch a flare near the transition to Woods (behind the depot). Quest case: “Ticket Handed Over to Prapor”  — he will immediately send you to find AMG-10 aviation oil (see below). Quest case: “Ticket Kept for Yourself”  — he will ask you to hand over 3  Military Filters  marked “Found in Raid.” Then Prapor sends you to the Reserve location to search for AMG-10 aviation oil. Possible spawn locations: Helicopter in the courtyard: inside or nearby next to the forklift; School building (“Black Bishop”) in the basements. Reserve Reserve AMG-10 fluid in a helicopter Boreas Reserve AMG-10 fluid in the basement of the training center on the shelf Boreas Reserve AMG-10 fluid near the loader next to the helicopter Boreas Spawn inside Helicopter in the courtyard Spawn nearby next to the forklift School building (“Black Bishop”) spawn in the basements on the shelve Next, go to the BTR Driver, who is supposed to help arrange transportation to the Icebreaker. Depending on the completion of his questline and the decisions made during it, there are three possible outcomes: Questline completed with the good ending  — the Driver helps you for free. He tells you about smugglers at the pier on Shoreline who are willing to transport you to the Icebreaker for 400k roubles. Questline completed with the bad ending (Skier route)  — you must bring the Driver 200 rounds of  7.62x54mm R BT gzh  ammunition (Found in Raid status not required). Then you need to locate Skier’s documents on Customs and burn them in any barrel.  Find Skier’s documents on Customs map Customs Documents of Skier Boreas . After that, you must kill 15 targets of any kind in smuggler camps on Interchange or Shoreline. Driver questline NOT completed  — he asks you to kill 10 targets of any kind in smuggler camps on Interchange or Shoreline. Find the smuggler camp on Shoreline. Shoreline The smugglers camp on the Shoreline Boreas Find the smuggler camp on Interchange. Interchange Smugglers camp on the Interchange Boreas After completing the tasks from both the BTR Driver and Prapor, you gain access to the Icebreaker. To enter, you need: 400,000 roubles  for entry (departure from Shoreline at Norvinsky Port via boat); 2,500 euros  and a  green RSP flare  for extraction from the location by helicopter. Find the boat to the Icebreaker on Shoreline. Shoreline Boat transition to the Icebreaker Boreas Icebreaker Walkthrough For your convenience, the guide is also available on the Icebreaker map. Preparing for the Raid Before entering the raid, it's highly recommended to bring your best gear. On Icebreaker, you'll face heavily equipped enemies, so don't skimp on armor, meds, or ammunition. Bringing some provisions is also useful, along with a flashlight or night vision device, as certain sections of the ship are very poorly lit. Don't forget  €2,500  for the helicopter extraction and a  Green RSP flare  (if you forget it, you can pick one up near the start of the location). Weapons chambered in  5.56×45  are strongly recommended. Black Division operatives frequently use the  M4A1  and its variants, allowing you to replenish ammunition during the raid by looting magazines from fallen enemies. First Steps Aboard the Ship You have  40 minutes  to complete the raid. Icebreaker consists of multiple decks connected by compartments and corridors, so progression largely revolves around opening doors and clearing rooms. You spawn on the nighttime version of the location. Near the starting area, you can find a green  RSP-30 signal flare , as well as various tools and consumables. Advance carefully. You'll encounter both  Renegades  and  Black Division  units. These are extremely dangerous enemies equipped with top-tier armor, large health pools, and powerful weapons. Finding the Keycard After the raid begins, move along the left side of the deck and open the blast door. Proceed through the next door, where you'll encounter enemies, including  Knight  and several Renegades. Continue through the corridors until you reach the  Infirmary . Inside one of the rooms, you'll find the body of an engineer. Search it and take the keycard required for further progression.  Find keycard on Icebreaker map Icebreaker Engine room keycard Boreas . Clear nearby compartments of Renegades to make navigation through the ship significantly easier later on. First Door with the Renegades Meeting Point with the Renegades and Knight Path to the Engineer's Body Keycard on the Engineer's Body Contacting the Crew Return to the main corridor and locate the intercom.  Find Intercom on Icebreaker map. Icebreaker Intercom of Scientist room  Use it to contact a surviving crew member and receive a quest update. Keep in mind that this dialogue can only be triggered once. Even if you die afterward, this step will remain completed. Intercom for Contacting the Scientist Lower Decks and the Arrival of Black Division With the access card in hand, head down to the lower decks and find the door with a keypad. Use the keycard to unlock it. Upon entering, a cutscene will play, showing Black Division forces arriving aboard Icebreaker. Continue through the corridors until you reach the  Engine Room .  Find way to Engine Room on the Icebreaker map. Icebreaker Way to engine room  Once you move into the central section, the first major enemy wave will appear. Expect roughly six Black Division operatives. Fight carefully using cover, peek corners whenever possible, make active use of grenades, and catch enemies while they're repositioning. After clearing the area, be sure to loot the bodies. These enemies often carry unique equipment, gas masks, and other valuable items. Engineer's C-1 Keycard Panel Machine Room, first BD fight Reaching the Helipad After securing the Engine Room, make your way to the upper levels of the ship.  Find stairs to roof on Icebreaker map. Icebreaker Stairs to the roof of the engine room  When you reach the helipad, be prepared for another Black Division squad positioned behind containers and crates. Eliminate all hostiles before stepping onto the open platform. This is one of the extraction points. To activate it, fire a  Green RSP flare  from the center of the helipad. Approximately  40 seconds later , a helicopter will arrive. If any enemies remain nearby, they may attack you while waiting for extraction. Important:  Do  NOT  shoot the helicopter after it arrives, or the extraction will be canceled. Helicopter Route Helipad Continuing the Storyline If you want to progress the story, do not leave immediately. From the helipad, descend to the lower decks and move toward the bow of the ship. Along the way, you'll encounter additional Black Division patrols that must be eliminated. Circle around the front of the ship and reach the opposite side of the deck. More enemies may be present there. Icebreaker Icebreaker The way to the door with a chain, we go around the bow of the ship Icebreaker The way to the door with a chain, climb the stairs to the door Icebreaker The way to the door with a chain, we go down the stairs to the bow of the ship Continue until you find a door wrapped in chains. This is your objective. Opening it requires an explosive charge (covered later). Interacting with the door will update the quest. Deck Route Chained Door Finishing the Raid Once all required actions are completed, return to the helipad and call in extraction using the green flare. After successfully extracting, speak with  Mechanic . This unlocks the next stage of the storyline involving the explosives and the events aboard Icebreaker. Mechanic will recommend speaking with  Prapor , after which the  Explosive Charge SZ-1  becomes available for purchase for  170,000₽  (it can be placed in a Special Slot). This also unlocks a questline from the  BTR Driver , which eventually grants direct access to Icebreaker from the Hideout deployment screen. Begin this questline with  Stick To It Stick to It BTR Driver Saving Private Roman  and continue through the subsequent quests as they become available. Extraction Helicopter SZ-1 Charge (Prapor) Breaching the Sealed Compartment Before your next trip to Icebreaker, bring an explosive charge and a gas mask. The best option is a Black Division gas mask looted from operatives, but any model that provides gas protection will work. Once you reach the chained door, plant the charge and move to a safe distance. After the explosion, open the inner door, but don't rush inside.  Find the chain door on Icebreaker map. Icebreaker The way to the door with a chain, climb the stairs to the door Immediately beyond the doorway is a gas trap. You can either manually disable it or simply survive the exposure while wearing a gas mask. This marks the beginning of one of the most dangerous sections of Icebreaker. Boss Corridor Gas Tripwire Boss Corridor Smoke Encountering The Wedge Ahead lies  The Wedge , an elite unit even more dangerous than standard Black Division operatives. These enemies possess lightning-fast aim, exceptional accuracy, and top-tier armor-piercing ammunition. A single mistake can result in instant death. The boss usually spawns with  3–6 guards . They most commonly occupy the long corridor and the gymnasium on the right side. They frequently throw flashbangs, so stay alert. Before entering the corridor, it's recommended to throw a grenade immediately, as the boss may already be positioned there. At the time of writing, the most effective strategy is to engage the boss and guards through multiple smoke grenades. Make sure to set  Volumetric Lighting  to  Ultra  in the graphics settings, otherwise visibility inside smoke will be extremely poor. Use the smoke to bait enemies into pushing your position and eliminate them as they advance. There's a good chance this tactic will be adjusted in future patches, but it currently works well. If you're lucky, you can also fire an  RShG  down the corridor and potentially one-shot the boss and his entourage. After eliminating the group, thoroughly search the area. Their bodies can contain various keycards and rare items required for future quests and valuable loot. Finding the Gas Cutter and CQ keycard While on this floor, make sure to visit the kitchen. A  gas cutter  can be found there, and you'll need it much later to access one of the story routes. If you miss it now, you'll have to return to Icebreaker later. A  CQ Crew Keycard  can also spawn in the same area. Icebreaker Icebreaker The gas cutter is in the drawer Icebreaker The gas cutter at the frying pan Icebreaker Icebreaker CQ key card, gym spawn Boreas Icebreaker CQ key card, gym spawn on the table Boreas Icebreaker CQ key card, spawn in the canteen Boreas Icebreaker CQ key card, canteen spawn on the couch Boreas Icebreaker CQ key card, canteen spawn on the table Boreas Gas Cutter Spawn CQ Keycard Spawn Ascending to the Upper Levels Continue upward through the ship. To progress further, you must climb two decks above the boss area. Along the way you'll encounter: Keypad-locked doors Keycard-restricted rooms Locked technical compartments Codes for most doors can be found on nearby boards. These are usually random four-digit combinations. Inside, you'll often find valuable loot and rare electronics.  Find board with code on Icebreaker map. Icebreaker Board on the wall with random code Boreas Random Code Board On the fourth tier, you can locate an office containing documents. Access requires either a  Crew Keycard  or a  C-1 Keycard . These documents may be useful for future story quests, making them worth collecting in advance. The Keypad Door Continue ascending toward the upper decks. In one compartment you'll find a sealed door leading outside. Exit through it, climb the exterior staircase, and open the white door at the top. Inside is a keypad-locked door.  Find the door with keypad on Icebreaker map. Icebreaker Door with keypad, code 312220  Visiting it for the first time updates the storyline, but not everyone will be able to open it immediately. To obtain the code naturally through the questline: Return to the Scientist and obtain the first part of the combination. Speak with Mechanic to receive the second part. He'll send you to plant device on The Labs, if you didn't do it during Blue Fire quest.  Find place of planting the device on The Labs map The Lab Planting location of Mechanic device Blue Fire If you've already completed those quests, the full code will be available immediately. Alternatively, you can enter the static code directly: 312220 The Keypad  The Captain's Bridge After opening the door, continue through the corridor. Roughly six Black Division operatives can spawn in the rooms ahead. Clear them and proceed toward the captain's area. This section contains a large amount of valuable loot, including new electronic items needed later: Ultralink  (x3); Memento  (x4); Gigachad  (x2). These items are required for future data decryption. Exit outside and climb the stairways to the top until you reach the bridge. At the top you'll see a hatch that must be opened using the gas cutter found earlier. Cut it open and jump inside.  Find the hatch on Icebreaker map. Icebreaker Lock on the captain's roof, opened by a gas burner Inside the bridge you'll find the captain's body. Nearby lies the  C-1 High-Level Access Keycard . Make sure to take it.  Find C-1 Keycard on Icebreaker map. Icebreaker Keycard C-1 with the captain Captain's Bridge Route Captain's Bridge Route Roof Hatch Opened with a Gas Torch Captain's body with keycard Speaking with the Scientist After obtaining the captain's keycard, contact the Scientist through the intercom.  Find Intercom on Icebreaker map. Icebreaker Intercom of Scientist room  Inform him about the death of the crew and the captain. You'll learn that the Scientist is ready to leave the ship, but ordinary extraction isn't acceptable to him. To arrange evacuation, you'll need to work with the  BTR Driver . Server Room and Archive Drives For the next stage, return to Icebreaker's upper levels. Near the central staircase is the server section. The door requires the  C-1 Keycard . Inside, locate  three archive drives . Their locations are marked by the quest, making them difficult to miss. Valuable loot also spawns here. Also there's a quest document on the wall next to the server room, don't forget to pick it up. Icebreaker Icebreaker Server room opened by C-1 card Icebreaker Document on the wall near the server room  After collecting all drives, return to the Hideout and hand them over to Mechanic for decryption. Server Room with Drives and Quest Loot Preparing the Scientist's Evacuation After speaking with the BTR Driver, you'll discover that additional equipment is required for a safe evacuation. You must provide: 5 respirators or gas masks A  Kirasa-N  body armor Two Class 5 (or higher) armor plates compatible with the Kirasa-N You must also eliminate  20 enemies  on Icebreaker. Once all requirements are met, speak with the BTR Driver again for further instructions. The Code Phrase Your next objective is to inform the Scientist about the upcoming evacuation. Return to Icebreaker, contact him through the intercom, and relay the code phrase provided by the BTR Driver.  Find Intercom on Icebreaker map. Icebreaker Intercom of Scientist room  Afterward, report back. In return, the BTR Driver will provide a  single-use C-3 Keycard . Final Visit to the Scientist's Shelter Before the next raid, bring a  Audio recorder . Reach the Scientist's laboratory, use the C-3 card on the intercom, and enter. The Scientist will already be gone. Inside you'll find: A story-related audio cassette ( find the cassette on the map Icebreaker Cassette in the Scientist's Office Boreas ) Large quantities of medical supplies Rare medical items (four  LEDX  units can spawn on one of the tables) Valuable loot in adjacent rooms Since the C-3 Keycard is single-use, loot everything thoroughly. It's highly recommended to listen to the cassette immediately, as it contains important information about Icebreaker's story. Cassette Inside the Scientist's Room  LEDX Inside the Scientist's Room Decrypting the Archives To fully process the archive drives, Mechanic requires additional hardware. You'll need: 3  Ultralink  Satellite Communication Modules 4  Memento  Server Memory Modules 2  Gigachad  Cryptographic Processors Most of these items are found exclusively on Icebreaker, usually behind locked doors and inside electronics-rich areas. Turn them in to Mechanic as you find them. Once the decryption process is complete, he'll send the resulting files through in-game mail. Story Finale After receiving Mechanic's message, open the archive data and carefully study the documents. Reading the files completes the Icebreaker storyline and awards the achievement:  "Cracks in the Ice" .  Yes This  quest item  can only be found if the quest is active.When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. There are multiple spawns for the  V3 flash drive  at the black (southern) chalet on  Lighthouse Lighthouse . After obtaining it, you have to reflash the  transmitter Digital secure DSP radio transmitter  at the Intelligence Center level 2 in the  Hideout . Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. After the reflashing is done, the transmitter is fully functional and can be used to bypass the  Claymores  and  Zryachiy Zryachiy One of Tarkov's most mysterious figures. Virtually nothing is known about his past, except that he has sniper training and is remotely rumored to have been in hot zones in the Middle East and Africa many times.
Long before the conflict, he became Lightkeeper's loyal lapdog and took an active part in "establishing" connections between Lightkeeper and all those with whom he interacted. He is known to be friendly with the Rogue group, as well as with the hooded men who draw mysterious symbols on the locations.
Zryachiy is very taciturn, though those who work with him usually understand him without words. There are many rumors about his eyes, some say that it is an inborn peculiarity, some point to certain eye drops that allow him to enhance his vision in the dark, giving his eyes this whiteness side effect. Despite the appearance, it seems that he earned his name precisely for his excellent eyesight, which is not surprising for a former military sniper. To successfully eliminate Zryachiy, you first need a long-range rifle with high-magnification optics, as engaging him in close-quarters combat on the open isthmus is a guaranteed death sentence. It is best to take a position on the cliffs of the mainland from which the entire lighthouse is visible. Before opening fire, make absolutely sure that you see not only the boss himself but also his two guards covering the flanks. It is recommended to start the attack by eliminating the guards first. If you kill Zryachiy first, his followers will immediately change positions and begin extremely accurate suppressive fire, making them much harder to pinpoint afterward. Use calibers with high armor penetration and damage, such as 7.62x51mm or .338 Lapua, to ensure you take down targets with a single headshot. At night, the task is simplified thanks to thermal imaging, as the boss and his guards glow against the cold island background, and their detection range is slightly reduced. However, remember that at the first shots, they will begin actively using cover and parapets, so try to change your own position after each successful kill to avoid taking a retaliatory bullet to the head.  guarding the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula, allowing you to visit the lighthouse building and meet  Lightkeeper .
 Note: If not all members of your lobby-made group have an encoded transmitter, it will have the "blocked" state and the bridge can't be passed.

bolt-action sniper rifle. It was the first product developed by ORSIS, and is produced in their Moscow factory. The rifle was introduced in 2011 at the international exhibition of Russian weapons in Nizhny Tagil, and is entirely original, using no third-party components. The rifle ensures maximum comfort of the user while aiming and shooting, featuring a quick sighting line recovery, high reliability and ergonomics. The stainless steel barrel has a thread for installing a muzzle brake-compensator or a sound suppressor. The equipped muzzle brake-compensator effectively reduces impulse and allows the most comfortable recoil handling. It was the first product developed by ORSIS, and is produced in their Moscow factory. The rifle was introduced in 2011 at the international exhibition of Russian weapons in Nizhny Tagil, and is entirely original, using no third-party components. The rifle ensures maximum comfort of the user while aiming and shooting, featuring a quick sighting line recovery, high reliability and ergonomics. The stainless steel barrel has a thread for installing a muzzle brake-compensator or a sound suppressor. The equipped muzzle brake-compensator effectively reduces impulse and allows the most comfortable recoil handling. kolotun.name: Kolotun
kolotun.text: Kolotun Jaeger The task is not particularly difficult, but it is time-consuming. You need to extract from the location alive while having the  “Frozen”  status active. This effect is applied if you spend a long time outdoors and are exposed to the cold. You can check your character’s current condition in the  Health  tab. Important: do not wear headgear, as it warms your character and prevents you from getting the required status (such as the ushanka hat, pom-pom hat, or the SSH-68 steel helmet). The locations do not have to be completed consecutively, and dying in raids is allowed. Survive and extract with the "Frozen" status effect on the Streets of Tarkov location. Survive and extract with the "Frozen" status effect on the Epicenter location. Survive and extract with the "Frozen" status effect on the Interchange location. Survive and extract with the "Frozen" status effect on the Customs location. Survive and extract with the "Frozen" status effect on the Woods location.
