my-blood-type-mark-is-on-the-sleeve.name: My Blood Type Mark is on the Sleeve
my-blood-type-mark-is-on-the-sleeve.text: My Blood Type Mark is on the Sleeve Therapist Just like in the previous quests, obtain the key from a  Black Division Black Division The Black Division is a highly skilled, mysterious, and elite tactical unit in Escape from Tarkov lore, primarily acting as the clandestine, elite "cleanup crew" for TerraGroup. Known for appearing in the  Raid  series (Episode 5) and appears as a major threat only on the  Terminal Terminal The southern port Terminal has been under Russian Armed Forces control since the beginning of the Tarkov conflict. After the city was sealed off, the terminal was fortified and became the primary evacuation point, sought by both civilian refugees and PMC units. According to unconfirmed reports, TerraGroup personnel were also evacuated through this port.   and  Icebreaker Icebreaker  map, they represent a professional, western-equipped force that annihilates all witnesses. Elite NPCs: Found only on the Terminal and Icebreaker location, added in the 1.0 release Top-tier gear and armor Aggressive and highly accurate AI Operate as a team, flank, and use grenades How to fight them: 1. Don’t take head-on fights Play around cover, use quick peeks. 2. Keep your distance Mid-range is the safest option. 3. Split the group Lure them one by one, avoid fighting all at once. 4. Use grenades Force movement and break their positioning. 5. Aim for weak spots Head, face, chest. 6. Play off sound They are predictable through footsteps and actions. Recommended gear: Armor: Class 5–6 Ammo: High penetration Must-have: grenades  soldier or from  The Wedge The Wedge The Wedge  is an elite field commander of the classified  Black Division  faction operating within the Norvinsk region. Prior to his arrival in Tarkov, he served in the British Special Air Service ( SAS ), as indicated by his distinctive accent and flawless close-quarters combat skills. All official records of his past identity have been expunged. In Tarkov, The Wedge leads a containment operation aboard the atomic icebreaker  "Boreas"  under the orders of  Paradigm Shipping . His unit acts independently of both USEC and BEAR. The boss's primary mission is to eliminate all witnesses and suppress any classified data related to TerraGroup on the Icebreaker. The Wedge  is a dangerous boss who instantly opens fire to kill at medium and long ranges. The key to success is an aggressive assault using grenades (HE and flashbangs) that force the boss and his guards to change positions and stop firing. Use high-tier armor-piercing rounds (at least class 5 penetration), as The Wedge and his guards are protected by top-tier armor and have high HP pools. Also, keep in mind that the enemies actively throw flashbangs too. Aim strictly for the head and never peek the same angle twice — the boss locks his aim onto your last known position and will eliminate you instantly upon a re-peek. Currently, the most effective tactic is to gun down the guards and the boss under several deployed smoke grenades, and you MUST set "Volumetric Light" to Ultra in your graphics settings; otherwise, you won't see anything in the smoke. Next, lure them toward you and shoot them down, as the enemies start to bug out heavily inside the smoke. There is a suspicion that the developers will patch this, but at the time of writing, this method works. halloween-rumors.name: Halloween: Rumors
halloween-rumors.text: Halloween: Rumors Skier Enter the "Infected Factory" location Kill 10 infected at the "Infected Factory" location Accept the level 1 task from Skier. Switch to event locations in map selection and enter Infected Factory. Eliminate 10 infected. Bring spare loaded magazines; replenishing them under pressure is difficult. Watch for Infected Tagilla. The current guide lists Gate 0 and Gate 3 as the event Factory exits.

halloween-better-defence.name: Halloween: The Best Defense
halloween-better-defence.text: Halloween: The Best Defense Skier Enter the "Infected Laboratory" location Survive and extract from the "Infected Laboratory" location Find a clue for the secret extraction Kill 10 infected at the "Infected Laboratory" location After Rumors, enter The Infected Lab with a TerraGroup Labs access keycard. Complete all four objectives, including 10 infected kills and successful extraction. Find Car keys or a Collector map for the event exits. Check the circular conference room in the recreation area; the Collector map may also be on a PMC body in the server room. Choose Parking or Sewage Conduit according to the item you find. See the illustrations for reference.

halloween-control-check.name: Halloween: Follow-Up Examination
halloween-control-check.text: Halloween: Follow-Up Examination Therapist Locate the dead scientist in a hazmat suit on Infected Lab or Infected Factory Open the scientist's body using Medical instruments Obtain the blood sample on Infected Lab or Infected Factory Hand over the blood sample After Rumors, accept the task from Therapist. Bring 1 Medical tools set; collecting the sample consumes it. Find a dead scientist in a protective suit in The Infected Lab or Infected Factory. Interact with the body, collect the blood sample, survive, and hand it to Therapist. There are several possible locations shown in the illustrations. Death loses the sample.

halloween-unexpected-help.name: Halloween: Unexpected Help
halloween-unexpected-help.text: Halloween: Unexpected Help Skier Locate and obtain the vaccine shipment at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse Stash the vaccine shipment in room 105 of the two-story dorm on Customs After Control Check, accept the task from Skier and bring a Dorm room 105 key. Find the TG-VI-26 vaccine batch on the second floor of water treatment building 3 on Lighthouse. Survive with the case and stash it in room 105 of the two-story dorm on Customs. The quest item only appears while the task is active and is lost on death. Use room 105 as specified by the objective; the source table mentioning 205 appears to be a typo.
